phase3_findings.description: test_qualified_and_uppercase_calls_refused now has only the unqualified SELECT GET_LOCK('a', 1) row; the diff deleted every schema-qualified denylist case and ported none to mysql or no dialect.
DatabaseConfig.url scheme validator runs only at construction; no validate_assignment, so later assignment or model_copy(update=...) skips it.
